fact.en: Confusing the 4th Council: It was held under Kanishka in Kashmir, not in Pataliputra.
fact.hi: Confusing the 4th Council: It was held under Kanishka in Kashmir, not in Pataliputra.

fact.en: Assuming the Tripitakas were finished at the 1st council: Sutta and Vinaya were compiled, but Abhidhamma was added later.
fact.hi: Assuming the Tripitakas were finished at the 1st council: Sutta and Vinaya were compiled, but Abhidhamma was added later.

fact.en: Misidentifying the split: The formal split into Mahayana and Hinayana happened in the 4th Council, not the 3rd.
fact.hi: Misidentifying the split: The formal split into Mahayana and Hinayana happened in the 4th Council, not the 3rd.

fact.en: Ignoring the 'Fifth' Council: Mandalay (1871) is technically an international council, but for UPSC, focus on the 'Four Councils'.
